g.metadata: {"proof": "Theorem52; Exercise52", "projection": "Pi(A,B,R)=B; unital dg functor", "mapping_section": "j(B)=(I_prime B Q,B,0)", "homotopy": "h(A,B,R)=((-1)^r A H+R Q,0,0)", "mapping_deformation_retract": "partial h+h partial=1-j Pi", "kernel_only": "ker Pi contracted; entire target mapping complex remains a retract", "unit_defect": "1-j(1)=partial(H,0,0)", "relative_correction": "o=Dv-F_lower gamma; v_new=v-h o", "nonminimal_example": "du=v; prescribed v=(0,0,1); corrected u=(2,1,0)"}
g.text: Keep the native map; lift its graph comparison
The kernel is specific to full section-comparison maps.
Π : (A, B, R) ↦ B
j(B) = (I′ BQ, B, 0)
Πj = 1
The given entire B-cochain is retained exactly.
Every map keeps its source, target and parameter terms.
∂h + h∂ = 1 − jΠ
h² = hj = Πh = 0
On ker Π, the right side is the identity.
The target mapping complex remains a retract.
Unit defect: 1 − j(1) = ∂(H, 0, 0).
Relative correction retains the incoming unary term
o = Dv − F_lower γ; v_new = v − h o
du = v; fixed v-face: (0, 0, 1)
initial u: (1, 1, 0)
corrected u: (2, 1, 0)
Ignoring du would incorrectly leave zero defect.
Full mapping retraction and relative coherent lifting: Theorem 52.
Prescribed face, nonminimal generator and retained R: Exercise 52.
Source of the contraction and dg comparison category: Theorems 47, 49.
